guitar.evidence: Jimi Hendrix's white Fender Stratocaster (played upside-down/restrung for a right-handed guitar as a left-handed player) is one of the most iconic guitar associations in rock history.

tone.target: psychedelic Hendrix fuzz with wah and roomy delay/reverb
tone.profile: psychedelic Hendrix fuzz with wah and roomy delay/reverb
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Wah -> Boost/OD -> AC30 TB -> UK Vintage 4x12 -> Chorus -> Digital Delay -> Plate Reverb

rig.name: Jimi Hendrix - Night Bird Flying - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from high-gain fuzz.
Provide the core psychedelic Fuzz Face style sustain and texture.

alternatives.model: Red Haze (for a slightly different grit)

blocks.purpose: Emulate the signature wah pedal sweeps required for Hendrix's sound.
Add a slight edge and boost the signal before the main amp stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate the Vox/Marshall edge without using an explicit Boost pedal, maintaining the fuzz focus.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if a cleaner push is needed)

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British clean/crunch tone associated with Hendrix.

alternatives.model: UK 45 (if a more aggressive, rock sound is desired)

blocks.purpose: Ground the sound with a classic British cabinet tone.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (for a slightly more open sound)

blocks.purpose: Add a wide vibrato/shimmering effect to enhance the psychedelic feel.
blocks.gap: The Chorus provides the 'wide vibrato' feel requested, simulating subtle pitch modulation.

alternatives.model: Tremolo (if a more rhythmic wobble is preferred)

blocks.purpose: Create the 'roomy delay' effect for depth and space.

alternatives.model: Tape (for a warmer, less defined echo)

blocks.purpose: Provide the 'springy reverb' and general room ambience.
blocks.gap: While Spring is available, Plate offers a more controlled, professional decay that works well with fuzz/delay. We use it for its spaciousness.

alternatives.model: Spring (for a true vintage spring reverb sound)

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the vintage, room-drenched sound of psychedelic rock.

proposals.reason: The current cabinet is too clean; a vintage, room-mic'd IR will add necessary grit and depth.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased harmonic richness and perceived size.
